name: Days of Memories  ~Ooedo Ren'ai Emaki~
original_name: Days of Memories 〜大江戸恋愛絵巻〜
source: In eighteenth-century Japan, a wandering ronin decides to spend a month in Esaka, a city full of characters from the Samurai Spirits series. It's a violent city where swords clash in the streets, but perhaps, if he makes the right decisions, love might blossom here for him.
